ownership.summary: Stanley Black & Decker, Inc. owns BLACK+DECKER. The present group was formed when The Stanley Works and The Black & Decker Corporation completed their merger in March 2010. DEWALT, STANLEY and CRAFTSMAN are sibling brands; none is BLACK+DECKER's parent.

leadership.name: S. Duncan Black
leadership.context: The official brand history identifies S. Duncan Black as one of the two founders of the Baltimore machine shop opened in 1910.

leadership.name: Alonzo G. Decker
leadership.context: The official brand history identifies Alonzo G. Decker as the other co-founder of the business that became Black & Decker.

productPortfolio.name: dustbuster handheld vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: Cordless handheld cleaners span quick-clean, pet, wet-dry and removable-battery formats.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Compare voltage, battery inclusion, filtration, runtime, regional model number and replacement-filter availability.

productPortfolio.name: Cordless stick and floorcare products
productPortfolio.positioning: POWERSERIES and related lines extend the brand into whole-home dry floorcare.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm battery-platform compatibility, floor tools, parts and warranty terms for the destination market.

productPortfolio.name: Steam, wet-dry and surface cleaning
productPortfolio.positioning: Steam mops, wet-dry cleaners and portable products broaden BLACK+DECKER beyond dry vacuuming.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Licensed and regional products may use different responsible companies and compliance files.

productPortfolio.name: Power tools and outdoor equipment
productPortfolio.positioning: Home-improvement tools and yard equipment form the wider battery and retail ecosystem around cleaning products.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Shared branding does not guarantee cross-category battery, accessory or service compatibility.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: BLACK+DECKER's official support page describes tools manufactured in the United States, Mexico, Brazil, China and the United Kingdom.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not generalize this footprint to a specific vacuum, steam cleaner or licensed home appliance.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The official U.S. terms say the website may sell licensed products made or distributed by third-party partners.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Identify the manufacturer, distributor and warranty company named for the exact SKU.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Stanley Black & Decker reports a multi-country manufacturing and sourcing network at group level.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the product label, declaration, certification and shipment documents to the contracted batch.

marketsChannels.evidence: BLACK+DECKER sells through its own U.S. ecommerce site and major retail, online and dealer channels.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm seller authorization and whether the purchase qualifies for local warranty coverage.

marketsChannels.evidence: Stanley Black & Decker uses regional entities and country sites across major markets.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Use the legal name on the local terms, invoice, importer label and warranty policy.

marketsChannels.evidence: The group maintains separate support paths for BLACK+DECKER, DEWALT, STANLEY and other portfolio brands.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Do not route a BLACK+DECKER claim through a sibling brand's service system without confirmation.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: BLACK+DECKER combines exceptional consumer recognition with a broad dustbuster-led floorcare range and access to a large tool-and-outdoor platform. The commercial diligence risk is portfolio complexity: owned, sourced and licensed products may use different manufacturers and service routes.
